description_expanded: This new vacation rental offering is located on the 4th and top floor of The May building and offers a large balcony with views of the town center as well as a view to the South toward the Gulf. Enjoy these views from the large balcony adjacent to the main living space. The condominium features a large living and dining space located just off of the kitchen. The primary bedroom features a king-size bed and a walk-in shower. The other two bedrooms, one with a queen-sized bed, the other with a king-sized bed, feature private baths. Parking for this residence is one designated space in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
